description: The Rooster in the Chinese zodiac: precision, candour and diligence, its Metal element, years from 1969 to 2029, and its San He, Liu He and Liu Chong matches.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Rooster is the tenth animal of the twelve-year cycle, with Metal as its fixed element and Yin polarity. It is traditionally associated with precision, candour and diligence. Your animal follows the Lunar New Year of your birth, so early-year birthdays can belong to the previous animal.

sections.heading: The Rooster in Chinese astrology
paragraphs: The Rooster is the tenth animal of the cycle and is usually described as observant, hardworking and confident. Its branch, You, is linked with mid-autumn, and its fixed element is Metal, associated with precision and clarity. People born in Rooster years are often portrayed as organised, honest and detail-oriented, with high standards and a striking sense of presentation. The Rooster is associated with punctuality, courage and outspokenness, as befits the bird that announces the dawn. Descriptions also mention perfectionism and bluntness: a Rooster may criticise freely and find it hard to relax its standards. Many readings present it as reliable, capable and loyal, with a strong sense of responsibility for getting things exactly right.

Many readers recognise the Rooster in a sharp eye for detail and an honesty that does not soften its opinions much. As a Yin animal, its strength is precise and focused, and it often takes pride in doing things correctly rather than quickly.

sections.heading: The Rooster at work
paragraphs: At work, the Rooster is often described as efficient, meticulous and dependable. Accounting, administration, the military or police, journalism, medicine, design and any role requiring precision and organisation are commonly mentioned. A Rooster tends to plan carefully, notice errors and hold itself and others to high standards. The traditional caution is perfectionism and bluntness: a Rooster may micromanage or deliver feedback in ways that feel harsh. Readings often suggest that people born in Rooster years do best in roles where accuracy is valued, and that they build stronger teams by pairing their critiques with recognition, so that high standards feel like support rather than judgment.

A Rooster also tends to be the colleague others rely on to check the final version, and it often takes responsibility for standards that no one else wants to enforce. Recognition for that role, not only for big results, tends to keep a Rooster motivated.

sections.heading: The Rooster in relationships
paragraphs: In relationships, the Rooster is usually described as devoted, honest and protective, showing care through practical effort and loyalty. A Rooster often plans thoughtfully and takes its responsibilities seriously. Its classical allies are its San He partners, the Ox and the Snake, and its Liu He secret friend, the Dragon, while the Rabbit sits opposite it in the six clashes. The common relationship friction is criticism: a Rooster may point out flaws or insist on its own way of doing things. Partners who are secure, appreciative and willing to give honest feedback in return tend to find the Rooster loyal and dependable, especially when they acknowledge the care behind its precision.

Friendships with a Rooster are often built on honesty and reliability. It tends to give practical advice and to show up when it says it will, and it values friends who appreciate frankness. Beneath the confident manner, a Rooster often cares deeply about being respected.

sections.heading: Years of the Rooster and their elements
paragraphs: Recent and upcoming years of the Rooster are 1969 (Earth), 1981 (Metal), 1993 (Water), 2005 (Wood), 2017 (Fire) and 2029 (Earth). Each begins at Lunar New Year rather than on January 1, so people born in January or early February need to check the date: in 1969, for example, the Rooster year began on February 17, and anyone born before that is a Earth Monkey. The element attached to each year comes from the ten-year cycle of heavenly stems, so a Earth Rooster and a Metal Rooster share the animal's core character but differ in flavour. Separately, the Rooster always carries Metal as its fixed element and a Yin polarity, which describe the animal itself. Because the five stem elements and twelve animals line up again only every sixty years, the Water Rooster of 1993 returns in 2053. The Chinese zodiac calculator on this site applies the Lunar New Year table from 1924 to 2044 automatically.

sections.heading: Growth edges for the Rooster
paragraphs: The growth edge for the Rooster usually involves flexibility and gentleness. Traditional descriptions mention perfectionism, bluntness, vanity and difficulty accepting criticism despite giving it freely. A Rooster may also feel anxious when things are disorderly. Practices that tend to help include softening feedback with appreciation, letting some details go, and making time for unplanned enjoyment. The Rooster's gift is clarity, the ability to see what needs fixing and to work diligently until it is done well. It tends to grow when that clarity is joined by warmth, so that high standards inspire others instead of discouraging them, and when the Rooster lets itself be imperfect.

In a Unified Reading, the Rooster often adds a note of precision and candour to the wider profile, sharpening a disciplined Life Path or Sun sign, or bringing structure to a looser one. For anyone born in a Rooster year, these growth notes are prompts for reflection rather than fixed traits.

faq.question: What does the Rooster symbolise in Chinese astrology?
faq.answer: Diligence, precision, honesty and courage. The Rooster is often described as organised and confident, with high standards and an outspoken manner.

faq.question: Which animals clash with the Rooster?
faq.answer: The Rabbit is the Rooster's Liu Chong clash and the Dog its Liu Hai harm. Its traditional allies are the Ox and the Snake in its San He trine and the Dragon as its Liu He secret friend.

faq.question: What years are the Year of the Rooster?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044 the Rooster years are 1933, 1945, 1957, 1969, 1981, 1993, 2005, 2017, 2029 and 2041. Each starts at Lunar New Year, which falls between January 21 and February 20.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Rooster?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Ox and Snake share the Rooster's San He trine and the Dragon is its Liu He secret friend. The Rabbit (Liu Chong) and the Dog (Liu Hai) are the pairings readings treat as needing more care.
